title: The House and the Door
oneLiner: AI opens the door to economic opportunity — and opportunity now starts with the human skills we all have.

madeFrom.summary: An example of agentic content creation: a two-minute talk turned into a 55-second animated explainer.
steps: Start with a recording: a 1:58 talk from AfroTech.
Transcribe it and generate a caption file.
Pull out the beats: six timestamped moments that carry the metaphor.
Storyboard one scene per beat, ending on the question for leaders.
Animate it: 55 seconds of on-screen text and illustration, with no voiceover.
Publish it as one lightweight web page that embeds in the hub.

metaphor.summary: Economic opportunity is a house. The labor market is the door, gated by degrees, job titles and pedigree. AI opens that door, and people can start from their strengths, not their deficits.
metaphor.coreImage: House and doorway as opportunity system

beats.label: The house
beats.quote: I've often thought about economic opportunity as a house.

beats.label: The door
beats.quote: The labor market is one of the least transparent and least dynamic markets humans have ever created.

beats.label: Three ways in
beats.quote: Some people were born in the house, some came through the front door with a degree, and others snuck through by starting a business.

beats.label: AI opens the door
beats.quote: AI is going to open the door — the most democratizing technology we've ever had.

beats.label: Strengths, not deficits
beats.quote: Everyone now doesn't start with deficits. They start with strengths.

beats.label: Needs review line
beats.quote: This is the moment where the door doesn't need to be open for you to get in.

leaderTranslation.headline: Where are the doors in your organization?
leaderTranslation.explanation: Inside a company, the door is degree requirements, title-gated promotion and closed internal mobility. Leaders can open those doors by hiring, promoting and paying for human skills.

explainer.title: The House and the Door in 55 seconds
explainer.description: Animated version of the metaphor in six scenes, with on-screen text and no voiceover.

roleGuidance.whenToUse: Executive conversations about AI transformation, workforce redesign and talent mobility.
roleGuidance.howToUse: Use the metaphor to diagnose talent gates, then move to discovery questions and practical next steps.

discoveryQuestions: Which roles still require a degree that the work doesn't?
How do people move into higher-value roles today, and who gets left outside?
Which human skills do your best people show that your systems don't measure?
Where could AI remove a gate rather than add one?
What would a strengths-first talent process look like here?
copilotPrompts: Using The House and the Door metaphor, draft three discovery questions for a CHRO at [customer] in [industry].
Turn this metaphor into a 60-second internal talk track for an account team preparing an executive workshop.
